note: Carroll County Conservation Board park (county-run despite the 'State Park' name). The campground sits on the lake's south side; the electric-only loops (A-P) run north through woods toward the fishing jetty. Reviewers report 28-35 ft rigs fitting (gravel, some grade; bring levelers). Hosts at sites 29 and 34, Memorial Day to Labor Day. Dump station $3 and showers $4 for non-registered visitors. --Claude
summary: County pages + campground map confirm 50-amp full hookups, two shower houses, dump, free Wi-Fi, FCFS only, 14-night max (long-term sites excepted), season late April to mid/end Oct. Count 117 numbered sites from the map legend. Fees ($18-20, tent $15) match the page. Lakeview kept (canopy). PIN ~950 m off, on the north side of the lake.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 42.04380,-94.84600 is on the park road NORTH of Swan Lake, ~950 m from the campground. The campground map puts the lake north of the campground; Esri shows the RV rows (sites 1-44) on the south side at ~42.0352,-94.8464. Re-pin to ~42.0352,-94.8464.

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept (could not earn on-water). The north tips of the electric-only loops (P/O and J/A on the map) reach the shore by the fishing jetty, ~20-50 m from the water, but a continuous wooded shoreline belt lies between them and the lake on Esri; the jetty is day use. No open apron. The rest of the campground is 100-300 m back in timber. The 2026-10 stored evidence coordinates (42.0415,-94.8460) are in the lake, not on the sites.

COUNT: official sources disagree slightly: park page says '44 full-hook up sites including 20 long term sites, 46 electric and water sites, 22 electric sites' in one paragraph and '45 ... 52 ... 21' in the next; brochure says '57 sites with water, sewer, and electricity, and 52 sites with electricity & water'; facility page 'over 115 campsites'. The map legend's site ranges give 44 + 52 + 21 = 117, used for count.
LONG-STAY: 20 of 117 sites are long-term; the rest are nightly with a 14-night cap. Not a long-stay park.
RATES are undated on the county pages (read 2026-11-04); fees left as stored (human-verified 2026-10-10).
